hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that computes dynamic LP fees from volatility (tick-distance accumulation relative to a reference price), collects protocol fees via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta hooks, and supports an optional MEV-protection module that can temporarily raise fees during pool launch and a pluggable pool extension for afterSwap actions.
